note: canonical-state.json is a committed, regenerable snapshot derived from event-log.jsonl (the sole source of truth). Enforcement is the CONSISTENCY invariant only, so a SYNTH regeneration that keeps them in sync never false-positives. Agents must not hand-edit canonical-state (SDK guard, ADR-051 §1); the system regenerates and commits it. AGENTS.md is excluded from this check to avoid false positives from legitimate `synth project AGENTS.md` regeneration.
